source_instruction: i want to purchase synthetic hair topper that are 18 inch long and have 4 clips of dark blonde hair with bangs.
query: Ugh, I spent all morning trying to figure out why my windowsill herb garden is wilting even though I water it every other day and keep it right by the kitchen window, my neighbor swears I’m overwatering but the basil still looks so sad and droopy no matter what I adjust, I even looked up three different beginner gardening guides last night to troubleshoot and none of the tips have worked so far, I also stopped by the pet store on my walk yesterday to look at those tiny fancy goldfish with the flowy fins and almost brought one home before I remembered I don’t have a tank set up yet. Anyway, I’m browsing the hair loss products section right now, can you help me find synthetic hair pieces that are 18 inches long, come in that light shade with the fringe and the little fasteners to hold it in place, and don’t cost more than $60?
